identity.description: Plain (plain.com): a customer support platform for B2B teams, with conversations/threads, customers, a Help Center, and a GraphQL developer API. Confirmed as the support product, not Plain the fintech data API (Plaid) or other 'Plain' brands.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe Plain as the support platform: its MCP docs reference conversations, Help Center, and customer records, and its GraphQL docs describe customer and thread lookups. Official site and docs are on plain.com.

auth.oauth_flows: OAuth app for calling the API as a workspace user; OAuth is also used by the official hosted MCP server. Specific grant types are not established.
auth.token_refresh: unknown for API keys (keys are static; rotate by creating several keys on a machine user). OAuth token refresh: MCP server requires openid and offline_access scopes.
auth.scopes_notes: API keys carry per-key permissions chosen at creation (e.g. customer:read, thread:read). Insufficient-permission errors name the missing permission.

access.production_restrictions: No app review found. Frontier plan is custom-priced; whether API access is gated by plan is not established.

write_ops: unknown; mutations not enumerated in fetched docs
api.limitations: Docs cover only the most-used operations and point to the schema for the rest. Vendor claims there are no API limitations versus the UI. Breadth rating rests on that vendor claim, not on a fetched operation list. Endpoint is UK region: https://core-api.uk.plain.com/graphql/v1 (POST only); other regions not checked.
